map.source: GLIM reprocessing of the 2026-10-16 route2 mapping bag (USB field_20261016/ros2_glim/route2_ros2), exported 2026-10-26
map.origin: sensor pose at the start of the route2 drive, at A (aejimun)

trajectory.columns: t x y z qx qy qz qw (map frame)
trajectory.note: NOT GLIM's own traj_lidar.txt. FAST-LIO /Odometry of the 2026-10-16 route2 drive (all) and right drive (first 100 m, A->D1), each lidar scan registered to this PCD by 2D ICP against wall-height columns. z = local PCD ground + 0.69 m (approximate). Used only for auto-init global-search candidates; replace with GLIM's traj_lidar.txt when available.

alignment.method: per-scan 2D ICP of /livox/lidar (0.2-1.5 m above the sensor, 2-30 m range) against PCD vertical-structure columns, correction interpolated over time
alignment.cross_check: route2 and right drives corrected independently agree within 0.07-0.57 m on their shared A->fork stretch
alignment.warning: a trajectory-only fit (nearest map point) looked like 0.03 m but was wrong by up to 6.7 m; do not use that method
